extra.final_summary: Question: average unit price per category. The only problem affecting the answer was 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 17 and 23), which I removed so no order is double-counted. Region had stray spaces/misspellings and Quantity/Revenue had negative values, but those columns are not used in this question, so I left them untouched. Final averages (45 rows used): Accessories $30.67, Electronics $360.00, Furniture $191.67, Office Supplies $11.40.
